name: dialog
description: A modal overlay that interrupts the user to present focused content or collect input. Built on Radix UI Dialog. Renders a full-screen backdrop with a centered popup; focus is trapped inside until dismissed.

intent.Form: Short data-collection task with inline cancel + action buttons. Use for editing a name, entering a URL, confirming with a text field.
intent.No close button: Informational prompt or programmatic multi-step flow — dismiss only via Escape or backdrop click.
intent.Sticky footer: Taller dialog with sticky heading + scrollable body + sticky footer. Use for longer forms where submit must stay visible.
intent.Scrollable: Sticky heading + scrollable body only, no footer. Use for read-only long content: changelogs, policies, previews.

composition.Form: backdrop + popup (V AUTO-LAYOUT): content (title + description) → input-field × 2 → Slot 1 → Slot 2 → footer (cancel + action buttons)
composition.Sticky footer: backdrop + popup (no root padding): heading (title + description + close ×) → body (scrollable) → footer (sticky, bg/subtle)
composition.Scrollable: backdrop + popup (no root padding): heading (title + description + close ×) → body (scrollable)

openClose.open: Controlled: open + onOpenChange props. Uncontrolled: defaultOpen. Typically via <DialogTrigger>.

behavior.preventBackdropClose: onInteractOutside={(e) => e.preventDefault()} on DialogContent — only for destructive confirmation flows.
behavior.focusTrap: Focus trapped inside DialogContent when open (Radix UI default). Tab cycles through focusable elements.
behavior.initialFocus: First focusable element by default. Override with autoFocus on a specific element.
behavior.focusReturn: Returns to trigger element on close.

scrollBehavior.Form: No internal scroll — popup grows with content.
scrollBehavior.Scrollable: body section scrolls independently — apply overflow-y:auto + max-height to body.
scrollBehavior.Sticky footer: body scrolls, heading and footer stay fixed — apply overflow-y:auto + max-height to body; footer position:sticky.

behavior.animation: Radix uses data-state='open'/'closed' on DialogContent and DialogOverlay. Shadcn wires CSS keyframe animations: fade-in + slight scale-up on open.

accessibility.dialogTitleRequired: Always include <DialogTitle> — use <VisuallyHidden> if not visually shown. Screen readers announce it on open.
accessibility.focusTrap: Active while open — Tab stays inside
keyboard: Tab / Shift+Tab to move focus inside dialog
Enter / Space to activate focused button

constraints: Use dialogs for tasks that require the user's full attention before returning — editing, confirming, collecting input.
Use Type=Form for short forms (2–4 fields); Type=Sticky footer for longer forms.
Keep dialog content focused on one task — if multiple sections are needed, use a sheet or separate page.
The cancel button in footer must be wrapped in <DialogClose> — it must dismiss the dialog.
Do not nest dialogs — open only one at a time; use Alert Dialog for secondary confirmation.
Do not use dialog for simple confirmations ('Are you sure?') — use Alert Dialog with role='alertdialog'.
If backdrop close is blocked, the close button in heading must be present.

useCases: User clicks 'Edit profile' and must save or cancel before returning to the page
User triggers a destructive action (delete record, revoke access) that requires a short confirmation form before proceeding
An onboarding flow needs to collect a name and email before the user can continue
A 'Create workspace' action requires 2–3 fields that should not navigate the user away
Terms of service must be reviewed and accepted before an action completes
A file upload triggers a rename dialog that must be resolved before the upload proceeds

Form.whenToUse: Short, focused data-collection tasks with 2–4 fields and inline footer buttons

No close button.whenToUse: Linear flows with no cancel path, or informational prompts where no action is required

Sticky footer.whenToUse: Longer forms or content reviews where the action buttons must always stay reachable

Scrollable.whenToUse: Read-only long content where the only exit is dismiss

comparedTo.situation: User must make a decision or complete a task before returning to the page
Simple 'Are you sure?' with no form fields
Secondary task that benefits from staying spatially connected to page content

notes: Type=Form has Slot 1 and Slot 2 between input fields for checkboxes, selects, helper text rows, or custom form elements.

darkMode.notes: Popup fill uses color/surface/default (Dark: zinc/900) — matches shadcn --card. Previously surface/overlay (zinc/800); changed to align with shadcn card/popover hierarchy.
